decisions.text: clamp reuses the shared toMilliseconds helper, parameterized with the caller name so its errors say clamp() while add()'s messages are unchanged
clamp is Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max) with no min<=max validation; inverted bounds yield max
`toSeconds` throws for non-string/non-number input and for non-finite numbers, mirroring the error style of `ms()` and `format()`.

add() follows toSeconds() conventions - each argument is a StringValue or finite number of milliseconds, strings go through parse() (NaN propagates), non-finite numbers and non-string/non-number types
